title: Application of New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc. for authorization and approval of: (1) proposed borrowings from New England Hydro Finance Company, Inc. not to exceed $133,800,000 under G.L. c. 164, § 14, as amended; (2) a proposed guarantee by Mass. Hydro of NEHFC's borrowings issued on behalf of Mass. Hydro, including interest, premium, and other costs related to these borrowings under G.L. c. 164, § 17A, as amended; (3) short-term investments under G.L. c. 164, § 17A, as amended; and (4) an exemption from the competitive bidding requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15, as amended; all in connection with the long term permanent debt financing of the expansion of the transmission interconnection between the electric systems in New England and Hydro-Quebec ("Phase II").
petitioner: New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc.
